title: export, install, trust and run
legs: run by name, dynamic left at check
prompt: Use the workflow tool for these calls, one after another. 1. argv ["check"] with this script: let meta = #{ name: "wf-live-exported", description: "Exported by the live matrix" }; let r = agent("Reply with the word exported.", #{ label: "exported", agent_type: "wf-live-worker" }); complete(r.output); It returns a script_id. 2. argv ["keep","<script_id>"]. 3. argv ["export","wf-live-exported"]. Then end your turn.
